hotel_name: Hotel Hari Nager By The Premium Villa

positive_snippets: Biggest mistake is, their Google maps location is wrong, around 1.5 km away, so call them before u go their. Only biggest plus is, cheaper prices and can't expect more. Biggest minus is, their rooms have no locks/keys. From inside u can lock, but outside u can't lock the room. For me, no security issues I felt, anyway didn't leave any valuables inside while going out. Rest, had a pleasant stay, AC, Geyser are there. No bed bugs issue..
Good hotel and very affordable and good service
Hotel is too good and staaf is very helpful and manager deep is very impressive person I hope uhh come in property and enjoy yoirs days
